nodes.name: PS-Out — Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Configurable recurring trigger for outreach preparation. Defaults to once a day -- change the interval in this node's parameters. Deactivate this node (or the whole workflow) to stop scheduled runs; PS-Out — Manual Trigger still allows on-demand testing while deactivated.

nodes.name: PS-Out — Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: On-demand execution for testing outreach preparation without waiting for the schedule. Feeds the same downstream path as the schedule trigger.

nodes.name: PS-Out — Fetch Ready Leads
nodes.notes: GET {{ $env.PERMITSIGNAL_API_URL }}/leads?commercial_readiness=READY_FOR_OUTREACH -- the existing Phase 4/6 retrieval boundary (backend/app/main.py), filtered to Phase 6's commercial_readiness classification. No lead selection/qualification logic is duplicated in n8n: the backend already decided which leads are commercially actionable (backend.app.services.commercial_lead_intelligence).

nodes.name: PS-Out — Split Ready Leads
nodes.notes: Fans the single /leads response out into one item per lead so each is prepared independently. A request failure upstream (no 'leads' array) simply produces zero items here rather than crashing the workflow.

nodes.name: PS-Out — Not Yet Contacted
nodes.notes: Only prepare outreach for leads still in a pre-outreach lifecycle stage (NEW/QUALIFIED/READY_FOR_OUTREACH -- see backend.app.services.outreach_intelligence). A lead already CONTACTED/REPLIED/ENGAGED/OPPORTUNITY/WON/LOST was already acted on by a controlled event and must not be re-prepared or re-surfaced as if it were new.

nodes.name: PS-Out — Fetch Outreach Package
nodes.notes: GET {{ $env.PERMITSIGNAL_API_URL }}/leads/{application_number}/outreach -- the Phase 8 outreach-preparation boundary (backend/app/main.py). Returns the selected contact target, recommended channel, and a personalized message draft built only from real PermitSignal evidence (backend.app.services.outreach_intelligence). This call never sends anything -- it is preparation only.

nodes.name: PS-Out — Has Usable Message
nodes.notes: outreach_intelligence.build_outreach_message() returns null when the lead has no usable email/phone -- never fabricates a contact to reach. Leads with no message are dropped here rather than surfaced to a human as if they were outreach-ready.

nodes.name: PS-Out — Mark Outreach Prepared
nodes.notes: POST {{ $env.PERMITSIGNAL_API_URL }}/leads/{application_number}/outreach/events {event: outreach_prepared} -- records that a draft was prepared for human review (outreach_status advances to READY_FOR_OUTREACH if it was still NEW/QUALIFIED). This does NOT send anything and does NOT require Supabase to already have this lead beyond what the pipeline already persisted.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { event: 'outreach_prepared', note: 'Prepared by n8n scheduled outreach-preparation workflow.' } }}

nodes.name: PS-Out — Build Review Summary
nodes.notes: Human/Controlled Approval step (CLAUDE.md Phase 8 section 11): this workflow ends here, at a structured item ready for a human to review and send through whatever channel they actually use (email client, CRM, LinkedIn, etc). Wire a notification node (Slack/Email/Sheet append) after this node for your own team -- none is included here since no such integration exists yet in this repo and one should not be invented. PermitSignal never sends outreach automatically. Once a human has actually sent the message, confirm it via: curl -X POST {{ $env.PERMITSIGNAL_API_URL }}/leads/{application_number}/outreach/events -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"event": "outreach_sent"}' -- see n8n/README.md.

string.name: next_action
string.value: Human review required. Once sent, POST /leads/{{ $json.application_number }}/outreach/events with {"event": "outreach_sent"}.
